description_for_human: Task management and GitHub workflow automation for rapid product development
description_for_model: TaskHub MCP enables complete task-to-PR workflows: create tasks, claim them, create branches, push code, open PRs, and post reviews. Supports JWT authentication and idempotency.

instructions.general: TaskHub MCP automates the complete software development workflow from task creation to pull request management. Personal setup uses no authentication for simplicity.
instructions.authentication: No authentication is required in this personal setup.
instructions.workflow:
Typical workflow:
1. Create task with POST /mcp/tasks
2. Claim task with POST /mcp/tasks/{id}/claim
3. Create branch with POST /mcp/tasks/{id}/branch
4. Push code with POST /mcp/tasks/{id}/patch
5. Open PR with POST /mcp/tasks/{id}/pr
6. Review with POST /mcp/tasks/{id}/review
best_practices: Always include meaningful acceptance criteria when creating tasks
Use descriptive commit messages that follow conventional commits
Include proper file paths and well-structured code in patches
Write helpful PR descriptions with checklists
instructions.error_handling: If you get authentication errors, get a new token. For validation errors, check the request format. For GitHub errors, verify repository access.

capabilities: Open pull requests with auto-generated checklists
Post code reviews with approval/comments/change requests
List and filter tasks by status, assignee, or repository
Support for multiple repositories and developers
